basis: Use verified patch523 level-0 to level-1 probability differences. Project them into existing host status_chance; preserve host resistance, boss factors, costs and failure behavior. This projection is a configurable TWILIGHT rule, not a claim about the full native hit formula.

invoke_probability_projection.basis: Only the native level probability difference is added to existing host proc/amplification payloads. Native attack type, weapon membership, by-spell and miss flags gate the difference; unknown context gives no difference. On a miss, keep the previously absent host base proc and use only the confirmed native level difference.

69601.basis_note: Native Restoration definition absent after source/report/official-guide review. Conservative maxHP5% level increment, one quarter of verified Dragon Force20%; preserve existing host base recovery120, caps and costs. Official guide confirms recovery role, not this coefficient.

95662.basis_note: Native self-recovery definition absent; do not add party recovery272. Conservative maxHP5% level increment preserves host base180 and existing overflow-shield cap/duration. Official update confirms self/party recovery and overflow role, not this coefficient.

pvp_training.basis: Opt-in local training consumer for the exact native relic-level PvP reduction delta only. Ordinary monster damage never consumes this stat. HP loss commits atomically before application; no currency/item costs or rewards. This is not a native network PvP engine.
